purpose: Every request document the CLI conformance producer drives the built tl-mltl binary over, and what each one is declared to do. The producer reads this file; it invents no case and skips none, and a case whose expectation this file does not state is refused rather than defaulted.
discrimination: An accepted request is judged by its exit status and by the fields its structured output carries, both of which are machine facts. A refused request has no structured output — the CLI writes a plain message to stderr and exits 2 — so the exit status is the primary fact and `stderrMarker` is the only discriminator between five different refusals. That is stated here rather than left implicit: without it, an unknown schema, an unknown profile, an unknown field, a missing trace and a profile/trace mismatch would all read as the same refusal, and a CLI that refused everything for one reason would look correct. Each marker names something only its own case can produce, and the producer emits a `marker-discrimination` row asserting that no case's marker appears in any other case's stderr — a marker that matches more than one refusal is a discriminator that discriminates nothing.
determinism: Every case is run twice and the two stdout byte strings must be identical. FR-005 requires deterministic machine output for identical input bytes, and a determinism claim that is never re-run is a claim nothing measured.

cases.why: A closed-trace evaluation over a closed trace document, which is the CLI's primary path.
Horizon analysis through the CLI, carrying the three resource values and their shared unit.
The C2PO adapter manifest through the CLI, carrying the exact source, dependency, input and output identities that make an external exchange attributable.
An unknown command schema identity is refused at the wire boundary rather than interpreted as v1.
An unknown semantic profile is refused. The profile is what fixes the meaning of every verdict below it, so guessing one is not available.
An unrecognised request field is refused rather than ignored. A field the CLI silently drops is a caller instruction that never happened.
Evaluation with no trace document is refused rather than evaluated over an empty one.

cases.stderrMarker: closed-trace formula requires a closed trace document
cases.why: A closed-trace formula handed an open prefix is refused. Closed and open are different semantics, not a default and an option.
